evidence.title: How Useful are LLMs for Grammar Engineering? Cantonese ParGram Resources and Controlled Experimental Evaluation with English Baselines

summary: Researchers assess the effectiveness of large language models in grammar engineering, introducing Cantonese ParGram resources and comparing performance against English benchmarks. The controlled evaluation highlights strengths and limitations of LLMs in linguistic applications.
title: Study Evaluates LLMs for Grammar Engineering with Cantonese and English Baselines
